Name: :code:`strict`
In CODESYS: A strict type test for the enumeration: no arithmetic with its values, no assignment of a value that is not one of them

Name: :code:`to_string`
In CODESYS: :code:`TO_STRING` of a value of the enumeration gives the name of the value

Name: :code:`qualified_only`
In CODESYS: A value of the enumeration, or a variable of the global variable list, is addressed only with the name of the type or the list

Name: :code:`pack_mode`
Stands before: array type, structure type, union type
In CODESYS: How the members of the structure are aligned in memory

Name: :code:`subsequent`
In CODESYS: The variables of the program or the global variable list are allocated one after another in memory

Name: :code:`hide`
In CODESYS: The declaration is not shown in monitoring, debugging, input assistance and the symbol configuration; it stays usable by name

Name: :code:`hide_all_locals`
Stands before: function, function block, program, method, property
In CODESYS: Every local variable of the block is hidden as by :code:`hide`

Name: :code:`conditionalshow`
In CODESYS: The declaration of a compiled library is hidden unless the library is opened with the matching option

Name: :code:`conditionalshow_all_locals`
Stands before: function, function block, program, method, property
In CODESYS: Every local variable of the library block is hidden as by :code:`conditionalshow`

Name: :code:`displaymode`
Value: one of bin, binary, dec, decimal, hex, hexadecimal
In CODESYS: The number format of the value while monitoring

Name: :code:`monitoring`
In CODESYS: How the value of the property is read while monitoring

Name: :code:`monitoring_display`
Value: a text that is not empty
In CODESYS: The member whose value is shown in the top line of a monitored instance

Name: :code:`monitoring_encoding`
In CODESYS: The string value is decoded as UTF-8 while monitoring

Name: :code:`obsolete`
Value: a text that is not empty
In CODESYS: A warning with the given text at each use of the declaration

Name: :code:`suppress_warning`
Stands before: any type declaration, function, function block, program, interface, method, property, action
Value: a text that is not empty
In CODESYS: The listed compiler warnings are not reported for the declaration

Name: :code:`no_assign_warning`
In CODESYS: Assigning an instance of the block to another instance is a warning

Name: :code:`estimated-stack-usage`
In CODESYS: The stack size in bytes that the stack check assumes for a recursive call

Name: :code:`no_assign`
In CODESYS: Assigning an instance of the block to another instance is an error

Name: :code:`no_instance_in_retain`
In CODESYS: An instance of the block in retain memory is an error

Name: :code:`enable_dynamic_creation`
In CODESYS: :code:`__NEW` may create an instance of the block

Name: :code:`analysis`
Value: negative rule numbers separated by commas, such as -33, -31
In CODESYS: The listed rules of the static analysis are not checked for the declaration

Name: :code:`noinit`
In CODESYS: The variable keeps its value when the application is reset

Name: :code:`initialize_on_call`
In CODESYS: The input variables of the block are initialised on each call

Name: :code:`global_init_slot`
In CODESYS: The place of the block or the global variable list in the order of initialisation

Name: :code:`call_after_init`
In CODESYS: The method runs after :code:`FB_Init` and after the initial values are assigned

Name: :code:`call_after_global_init_slot`
In CODESYS: The function runs after the global initialisation, in the order of the slot

Name: :code:`call_before_global_exit_slot`
In CODESYS: The function runs before the global exit, in the order of the slot

Name: :code:`no-exit`
In CODESYS: :code:`FB_Exit` is not called for this instance

Name: :code:`init_namespace`
In CODESYS: The string variable is initialised with the namespace of the library

Name: :code:`instance-path`
In CODESYS: The string variable is initialised with the path of the instance

Name: :code:`is_connected`
Value: a text that is not empty
In CODESYS: The Boolean variable tells whether the named input was assigned in the call

Name: :code:`reflection`
In CODESYS: The compiler looks in the block for :code:`instance-path` and :code:`is_connected` variables

Name: :code:`init_on_onlchange`
In CODESYS: The variable is initialised by each online change

Name: :code:`no_copy`
In CODESYS: An online change initialises the variable and does not copy its value

Name: :code:`call_after_online_change_slot`
In CODESYS: The function runs after an online change, in the order of the slot

Name: :code:`call_on_type_change`
Value: a text that is not empty
In CODESYS: The method runs when the type of one of the named function blocks changes

Name: :code:`linkalways`
Stands before: any type declaration, variable, function, function block, program, interface, method
In CODESYS: The declaration is compiled and downloaded even when nothing uses it

Name: :code:`no_check`
Stands before: function, function block, program, method, property
In CODESYS: The implicit check functions are not called in the block

Name: :code:`const_replaced`
In CODESYS: The constant is replaced by its value in the code

Name: :code:`const_non_replaced`
In CODESYS: The constant is not replaced by its value and stays a variable

Name: :code:`no_virtual_actions`
In CODESYS: The actions of the SFC block are not overridden by a block that extends it

Name: :code:`symbol`
Stands before: structure member, variable, function block, program
Value: no value, or one of none, read, write, readwrite
In CODESYS: Whether the variable is exported as a symbol and with which access

Name: :code:`io_function_block`
In CODESYS: The block is offered for a channel in the device configuration

Name: :code:`io_function_block_mapping`
In CODESYS: The parameter that is connected to the channel when the block is mapped

Name: :code:`pingroup`
Value: a text that is not empty
In CODESYS: The group of pins the parameter belongs to in FBD and LD

Name: :code:`pin_presentation_order_inputs`
Value: a text that is not empty
In CODESYS: The order of the input pins of the block in CFC, FBD and LD

Name: :code:`pin_presentation_order_outputs`
Value: a text that is not empty
In CODESYS: The order of the output pins of the block in CFC, FBD and LD

Name: :code:`dataflow`
In CODESYS: The input and the output through which the data flows in FBD, LD and IL

Name: :code:`ProcessValue`
In CODESYS: The member is offered by the CFC command that uses attributed members as inputs

Name: :code:`ExpandFully`
In CODESYS: The members of the array are shown in the properties of a visualisation
